entities.name: GraphRAG
entities.description: A framework for retrieval-augmented generation using graphs, discussed in the context of various retrievers.

entities.name: Non-parametric Retriever
entities.description: A type of retriever based on heuristic rules or traditional graph search algorithms that does not rely on deep-learning models.

properties.mechanism: Heuristic rules or traditional graph search

entities.name: LM-based Retriever
entities.description: A type of retriever utilizing Language Models for their natural language understanding capabilities.

entities.name: GNN-based Retriever
entities.description: A type of retriever categorized based on underlying Graph Neural Network models.

entities.name: Yasunaga et al .
entities.description: Researchers who retrieve k-hop paths containing topic entities.

entities.name: Taunk et al .
entities.description: Researchers who retrieve k-hop paths containing topic entities.

entities.name: G-Retriever
entities.description: A method that enhances the Prize-Collecting Steiner Tree algorithm by incorporating edge prices and optimizing relevant subgraph extraction.

entities.name: Prize-Collecting Steiner Tree
entities.description: A conventional algorithm enhanced by G-Retriever for subgraph extraction.

entities.name: Delile et al.
entities.description: Researchers who extract entities from queries and retrieve the shortest path related to these entities.

entities.name: Mavromatis and Karypis
entities.description: Researchers who extract entities from queries and retrieve the shortest path related to these entities.

entities.name: Retrieval Task
entities.description: The general task of retrieving relevant information from graphs, addressed by various retrievers.
